title: clang test build errors in master branch
body:
Some errors seem to have popped up recently related to compute_inverse and tmat2x2, see the error log at the end of this description.  Everything builds fine when I roll back to 4ac77c08c7696, so my guess is it is from promoting the template types form glm::detail to glm namespace.

Tested on Mac OS X, latest official clang (Apple LLVM version 6.0 (clang-600.0.51) (based on LLVM 3.5svn)).
